question: True out-of-sample test: on live signals from 2026-10-08 onward, which nobody had seen when this was registered, does the leading selling rule still grow the $100k account better than the current rule and SPY after risk?

variants.label: Current rule: support -5% (max 10%), sell all at 2R, 40 days

notes: Runs once, automatically, on the first lab run on or after not_before; the runner never runs it earlier.
Same approved $100k account as round 2. Same-day signals take free slots in SV ledger rank order; trades still open on the data date stay in the account at their last close.
Variants may be added or removed only before not_before and only from completed lab experiments; every change is recorded as an experiment event.
About six months of data: drawdown, Sharpe against the current rule and SPY, and the luck check decide; per-period and deflated Sharpe checks need a longer record.
